regime_context: Hong Kong regime is a narrow, non-directional rotation: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-eligible (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend, Conglomerates) with absorption 0.46 and one_narrative false. Leadership is concentrated in Banks/Energy/Dividend (all eligible), while the entire Tech & Internet complex (China Tech, Platforms, Hardware) is ineligible and at the bottom. No theme is crowded.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed leadership handoff from Banks to Energy: Energy (challenger, score 1.133 durable bar 0.77) overtakes Banks (leader, score 1.498) in the rotation read AND Energy's breadth stays above 0.7 while Banks' breadth falls below 0.5. If both do not happen, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the rotation with the top score (1.498) and are eligible under the absolute-trend gate. Durability bar 0.69 with mixed Hurst and breadth 0.69 suggests leadership is moderately broad-based. Crowding z 0.94 is below the crowded threshold, so no size-down caution. The trend-gate eligibility is the one validated leg here; rank is a focus lens only.
evidence: absolute-trend gate validated as drawdown control on this market (gate_helps true)
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mixed (not clean trend), and breadth 0.69 means rotation within the theme is only two-thirds participating — the lead could be carried by a few large state banks while the rest lag.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the strongest eligible challenger: score 1.133, durability bar 0.77 (highest in the set), clean 'trend' Hurst tag, and breadth 0.8 (most cohesive eligible theme). Margin to the leader Banks is 0.365 — close enough that a continued trend could confirm a leadership handoff on a narrow basis. No crowding flag.

falsifier.text: Energy breadth falls below 0.6 and Hurst flips from trend to mixed before the check-by date

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-dividend is the third eligible theme (score 0.935), with clean trend Hurst and solid breadth 0.75. It sits as a defensive/income leg in the same leadership cluster as Banks.
